samples.xml_description:
<module id="div_8bit">
    <description>Implement a simplified radix-2 divider on 8-bit signed or unsigned integers. The module accepts a dividend and a divisor as inputs and provides a 16-bit result containing both the quotient and the remainder. The design supports both signed and unsigned division operations.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">1-bit indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">1-bit indicates that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <input id="res_ready">1-bit indicates that the 16-bit output result has already been acknowledged.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready. res_valid must be constructed as combinational logic and not in any always block. So res_valid must not be declared as register.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit the output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">ADD=6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">SUB=6'b100010</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <description>divisor_extend: 9-bit combinational logic. divisor_extend is set to concatenation of bit 1 and input divisor if the input sign and MSB of divisor is high. Otherwise, divisor_extend is set to concatenation of bit 0 and input divisor.</description>
        <description>NEG_DIVISOR: 9-bit sequencial logic.</description>
        <description>all_sub_result 10-bit combinational logic.</description>
        <description>sub_result: 9-bit combinational logic. sub_result is the first 9-bit of all_sub_result.</description>
        <description>sub_remainer_reg_divisor: combinational logic operation. 10-bit all_sub_result is set to summation of REMAINER and NEG_DIVISOR.</description>
        <description>REMAINER: 8-bit combinational logic. This is a subsection of 8-bit MSB of SR.</description>
        <description>QUOTIENT: 8-bit combinational logic. This is a subsection of 8-bit LSB of SR.</description>
        <description>CO: 1-bit combinational logic. CO is set to the MSB of all_sub_result.</description>
        <description>mux_result: 9-bit combinational logic. If CO is high, mux_result is set to sub_result else set to REMAINER.</description>
        <description>quotient_shift: 7-bit combinational logic. quotient_shift is set to 7 [7:1] bits of SR.</description>
        <description>SR_final_update: sequencial logic operation. First, the 8-bit MSB of SR is set to 8-bit mux_result. Then bit [0:0] of  SR is set to CO.</description>
        <description>SR_shifting: sequencial logic operation. Concatenate SR from of first 7-bit of mux_result, 7-bit quotient_shift, 1-bit CO, and 1-bit zero.</description>
        <description>dividend_abs: 8-bit combinational logic. If sign and the MSB of input dividend is high, dividend_abs is set to two's complement of the input dividend. Otherwise, dividend_abs is set to the original input dividend only.</description>
        <description>final_remainer: 8-bit combinational logic. final_remainer is set to two's complement of REMAINER if the sign bit and MSB of register dividend is high. Otherwise, final_remainer is set to REMAINER.</description>
        <description>final_quotient: 8-bit combinational logic. final_quotient is set to two's complement of QUOTIENT if sign bit and MSB of divisor is high. Otherwise, final_quotient is set to QUOTIENT.</description>
        <description>is_final_quotient_sign: 1-bit combinational logic. is_final_quotient_sign is result of the and logic of sign and the xor logic of MSB of dividend register and MSB of divisor register.</description>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <description>Operation Start:</description>
        <description>When opn_valid is high, res_valid is low, and start_cnt is low, the module saves the inputs dividend and divisor in to 2 8-bit corresponding regisers.</description>
        <description>Initializes the 16-bit shift register SR with the absolute value of the original input dividend (dividend_abs) shifted left by one bit.</description>
        <description>9-bit NEG_DIVISOR is set to divisor_extend, if the sign bit and MSB of divisor is high. Otherwise, sets 9-bit NEG_DIVISOR to two's complement of the divisor_extend.</description>
        <description>Set the 4-bit counter cnt to 1 and start_cnt to 1 to begin the division process.</description>
        <description>Division Process(If start_cnt is high, the module performs the following steps):</description>
        <description>If most significant bit of cnt is set (the counter cnt reaches 8), the division is complete:</description>
        <description>cnt and start_cnt are cleared. Then, based on SR_final_update method, Updates the shift register SR with the final remainder and quotient.</description>
        <description>Otherwise, the counter cnt is incremented, and the shift register SR is updated based on the subtraction result mux_result:</description>
        <description>Based on sub_remainer_reg_divisor, compute the summation of NEG_DIVISOR and REMAINER.</description>
        <description>Based on SR_shifting, updates SR.</description>
        <description>Result Validity:</description>
        <description>res_valid is managed based on the reset signal, the counter, and whether the result has been consumed, which is signaled by the input (res_ready).</description>
        <description>res_valid is set to zero if rst is high.</description>
        <description>Otherwise, if cnt reaches 8, res_ready is set to 1.</description>
        <description>Otherwise, if res_valid and res_ready is all high, res_valid is set to 0. Otherwise, res_valid is set to res_valid.</description>
        <description>Result operation:</description>
        <description>result is constructed as combinational logic and set to concatenation of final_remainer and final_quotient.</description>
    </implementation>
</module>
